items.opus_reason: the psyche POSSESSES a common substratum, a constituent claim; the foundation reading would be structural-position
items.gemini_reason: A 'substratum' acts as a foundation, which defaults to structural-position per the boundary rules.

items.subject: tao

refs.quote: The unity of the two, life and consciousness, is the Tao

items.opus_reason: three-place union: the Tao is the unity of life and consciousness, the pair split between object and carrier
items.gemini_reason: Totality/unity claims where the subject IS the whole (the unity of life and consciousness) map to composition.

items.subject: animus

refs.quote: On a low level the animus is an inferior Logos, a caricature of the differentiated masculine mind

items.opus_reason: the low-level animus as a degraded showing of Logos (aspect-of shape); classification and correspondence compete
items.gemini_reason: Being 'an inferior Logos' classifies the animus as a type or instance of the concept Logos.

items.subject: anima

refs.quote: just as on a low level the anima is a caricature of the feminine Eros

items.opus_reason: the low-level anima as a degraded showing of Eros (aspect-of shape); correspondence competes
items.gemini_reason: Being a 'caricature of' is a form of characterization or distorted representation not covered by the existing families.

items.subject: consciousness

refs.quote: The text says that consciousness (that is, the personal consciousness) comes from the anima.

items.opus_reason: consciousness comes from the anima, origination; a dependence reading competes
items.gemini_reason: The quote frames the claim as an act of interpretation by a text ('The text says that...').

items.subject: ouroboros

refs.quote: the divine water or its symbol, the uroboros, means nothing other than the deus absconditus , the god hidden in matter

items.opus_reason: the uroboros means the hidden god in matter, an image claim
items.gemini_reason: The relation between the ouroboros and matter is mediated by the hidden god; it does not fit a direct family between the two endpoints.

items.subject: melusina

refs.quote: For anyone familiar with the subliminal processes of psychic transformation, Melusina is clearly an anima figure.

items.opus_reason: Melusina is an anima FIGURE, a figure carrying the content; symbolization competes
items.gemini_reason: Melusina is classified as an instance of an anima figure.

items.subject: the-sea

refs.quote: The sea ( mare nostrum ) of the alchemists is their own darkness, the unconscious.

items.opus_reason: the alchemists' sea IS their own darkness, the unconscious (projection thesis); symbolization competes
items.gemini_reason: The sea is a symbol that stands for the unconscious ('their own darkness').

items.subject: lumen-naturae

refs.quote: The lumen naturae is the natural spirit, whose strange and significant workings we can observe in the manifestations of the unconscious

items.opus_reason: the natural spirit shows its workings in the manifestations of the unconscious; an evidential/no-family reading competes
items.gemini_reason: epistemic discovery/observation is not covered by structural-position or manifestation

items.subject: oak

refs.quote: But a still greater, more impassioned concern appears to have been—one cannot very well say the “investigation”—but rather the experience of the unconscious.

items.opus_reason: a concern/preoccupation (aboutness) relation; telos competes but concern is not a stated goal

items.subject: self-knowledge

The false conclusion necessarily follows from the premise “Deus = Summum Bonum,”

refs.quote: it causes the psyche to be suspected of being the birthplace of all evil

items.subject: yahweh

refs.quote: God’s love and mercy are named his right hand, but his justice and his administration of it are named his left hand

items.opus_reason: the opposites are God's two hands, i.e. in him; the 'are named' framing pulls to doctrinal-attribution

items.subject: evil

refs.quote: so does not endanger the unity of the God-image. As a matter of fact, it guarantees that unity

items.subject: the-self

refs.quote: since the psychological self is a transcendent concept ... it can only be described in antinomial terms

items.opus_reason: the self can be described ONLY through antinomial terms, a stated requirement; a no-family reading of describability competes
items.gemini_reason: The object serves as the necessary means or instrument for describing the subject, fitting instrumentality.

items.subject: lapis

refs.quote: there is among certain of the alchemists, too, a tendency to give the lapis priority over Christ

items.gemini_reason: The priority is given by a specific carrier (certain alchemists), making it an act of attribution or valuation.

refs.quote: whether, in the end, it was Christ who was taken as a symbol of the stone rather than the other way round

items.opus_reason: an evaluative precedence claim, and hedged as a question; no family covers ranking

refs.quote: it seemed to the alchemists that their parallel with the stone served to illuminate and deepen the meaning of the Christ-image

items.opus_reason: the parallel served to illuminate and DEEPEN the meaning of the Christ-image, the widening of an interpretive basis
items.gemini_reason: Deepening the meaning is a hermeneutic effect not covered by psychic-effect or other existing families.

refs.quote: the regeneration in the font, in which the baptized swim like fishes
the baptismal bath was described as a piscina (fish-pond) quite early. This presupposes that the believers were fishes

items.gemini_reason: A three-place relation where the subject represents a third party as the object does not fit any existing family.

refs.quote: This shall be the second Antichrist, which shall persecute the said Church and its true vicar by means of the power of temporal kings

items.opus_reason: a named author's prediction, a speech act by a carrier; prefiguration competes

refs.quote: Symbologically, he is actually the hook or bait on God’s fishing-rod with which the Leviathan—death or the devil—is caught.
in Christian symbology the crucifix is the hook or bait with which God catches Leviathan

items.opus_reason: the bait by which Leviathan is caught - an act on the object; instrumentality has the direction inverted
items.gemini_reason: The relation 'is-bait-for' describes the subject as a means to catch the object, which does not fit the direction of instrumentality or any other family.

refs.quote: The transformation is brought about by the coniunctio

items.gemini_reason: 'dissolve' is a direct seed for the separatio/solutio class

items.subject: mother-complex

refs.quote: Typical effects on the son are homosexuality and Don Juanism, and sometimes also impotence.

items.opus_reason: Quote names these as 'typical effects on the son' — a dynamic outcome produced in a person, not mythological parenthood.
items.gemini_reason: 'produces' is a generation seed, bringing forth a psychological outcome

items.subject: demeter

refs.quote: Like Demeter, she compels the gods by her stubborn persistence to grant her the right of possession over her daughter.

items.opus_reason: Demeter given as an instance of the mother-complex type; the relation asserts membership between the terms, which is what separates this from an adduced amplificatory parallel.
items.gemini_reason: Demeter is adduced as a mythic parallel to explain the behaviour of the mother-complex

items.subject: archetypal-image

refs.quote: If the primordial images remain conscious in some form or other, the energy that belongs to them can flow freely into man.

items.opus_reason: The image acts on the energy, letting it flow freely; instrumentality is ruled out because the subject, not the object, is the means.
items.gemini_reason: channeling or permitting flow of energy does not cleanly fit instrumentality or psychic-effect

items.subject: man

refs.quote: The mother has from the outset a decidedly symbolical significance for a man, which probably accounts for his strong tendency to idealize her.

items.opus_reason: Idealizing is a dynamic operation directed at the object; the relation does not itself assert relocation of contents, which the separate projection edge already carries.
items.gemini_reason: no-family: 'idealizes' represents a subjective stance or attitude, which doesn't fit a dynamic psychic-effect or projection.

items.subject: reincarnation

refs.quote: Here the human personality is regarded as continuous and accessible to memory

items.opus_reason: Preserving the continuity of personality is a state maintained in the other term; no more specific family fits.
items.gemini_reason: no-family: 'preserves' is a maintenance of state rather than a dynamic psychic-effect, transformation, or structural-position.

items.subject: resurrection

refs.quote: the resurrection of the dead is the raising up of the corpus glorificationis , the “subtle body,” in the state of incorruptibility

items.opus_reason: The subtle body is acted upon and raised into incorruptibility — produces a state in; generation is weaker since nothing new is begotten beside a persisting parent.
items.gemini_reason: no-family: 'raises-up' describes the specific event of the resurrection acting on the subtle body, not cleanly fitting a defined family.

items.subject: the-mass

refs.quote: This rite may be a ceremony such as the Mass, where there is a transformation of substances.

items.opus_reason: The rite brings about the transformation of substances — a dynamic act with an outcome, the residual family after telos, dependence and generation fail.
items.gemini_reason: no-family: 'effects' (brings about) as a ritual action doesn't cleanly align with generation (begetting) or psychic-effect.

items.subject: rebirth

refs.quote: Rebirth is an affirmation that must be counted among the primordial affirmations of mankind. These primordial affirmations are based on what I call archetypes.

items.opus_reason: 'Based on' as foundation, which the composition/position rule routes to position; derivation is excluded because no tradition-to-tradition transmission is asserted.
items.gemini_reason: The motif of rebirth rests on (is based on or presupposes) the archetype as a standing foundation.

items.subject: khidr

refs.quote: Another notable parallel is the Islamic legend of the meeting of Moses and Khidr

items.opus_reason: An encounter between two figures; no family covers meeting/event — not kinship (no standing role), not union (no joining asserted).
items.gemini_reason: Meets is a narrative action between two figures, not covered by the relation families.

items.subject: persona

refs.quote: the danger is that they become identical with their personas—the professor with his text-book, the tenor with his voice

items.opus_reason: Relation string is 'possesses' but the quote asserts identity outright ('become identical with their personas'); identity claim of the terms wins over the surface verb per rule 2.
items.gemini_reason: Possession is a dynamic overpowering of the subject, fitting psychic-effect.

items.subject: individuation

refs.quote: Natural transformation processes announce themselves mainly in dreams.

items.opus_reason: The process shows itself in dreams — direction test holds (subject is the less formulable term), matching is-made-manifest-in.
items.gemini_reason: Announcing itself in dreams is a mode of appearance or occurrence that doesn't cleanly fit manifestation or position.

items.subject: meister-eckhart

refs.quote: I would mention Meister Eckhart’s vision of the “naked boy” and the dream of Brother Eustachius.

items.opus_reason: Carrier-bound: remove Eckhart and the claim collapses. Strained because a vision is not a predication act; unclassified(no-family) was the alternative.
items.gemini_reason: An act of envisioning or experiencing a vision by a historical person lacks a family.

items.subject: divine-child

refs.quote: manifestation of the child motif in the therapy of neuroses is in the maturation process of personality induced by the analysis of the unconscious

items.opus_reason: The quote says 'manifestation of the child motif ... in the maturation process' — the motif showing itself in a process.
items.gemini_reason: Emerging 'in' individuation places the motif within a process/structure, rather than taking a guise.
